slide.text: The Chinatown Mural Project is a collaboration between activist Karlin Chan and artist Peach Tao. Together, they are bringing back large scale murals to the Chinatown area and beyond. The whimsical and fun culturally appropriate murals depict the culture, history and everyday lives of the community that locals and visitors can relate to.
The facade of the home located at Richmond and North Avenue in Plainfield NJ, has been turned into the canvas for a mural.
